provenance: AIME24, s1-32B. Verbatim from Muennighoff et al. 2025 's1: Simple Test-Time Scaling': budget forcing (appending 'Wait' to prolong thinking) extrapolates AIME24 accuracy from 50% to 57%. x = number of 'Wait' appends; y = accuracy (%). Intermediate points interpolated along the reported upward extrapolation; flipAtPress marks where a representative problem flips wrong->correct.
